title: Planta Plant Care Event Failure Rate
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=planta:plant
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(care_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by plant_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Planta plant care event records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each plant name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize care_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per plant name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your Planta plant care event data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
